<FILENAME>ea029496901ex10-14.htm
<DESCRIPTION>FOURTH AMENDMENT TO DISTRIBUTION AND SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH VENTURE MEDICAL, LLC DATED JULY 17, 2025
<TEXT>
<HTML>
<HEAD>
     <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="text-align: right; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt"><B>Exhibit 10.14</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; color: red">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; color: red"><B>Please be advised that certain identified information
has been excluded in this Exhibit because it is the type of information that the registrant treats as private or confidential and is (i)
not material and (ii) would be competitively harmful if publicly disclosed. Information that has been redacted/omitted is symbolized by
&ldquo;[***]&rdquo;.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; color: red"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><B>FOURTH AMENDMENT TO</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><B>DISTRIBUTION
AND SERVICES AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">This Fourth
Amendment to Distribution and Services Agreement (this &ldquo;<B>Fourth Amendment</B>&rdquo;) is made by and between BioStem Technologies,
Inc., a Delaware corporation (&ldquo;<B>Company</B>&rdquo;) and Venture Medical, LLC, a Montana limited liability company (&ldquo;<B>Distributor</B>&rdquo;),
and is effective as of July 17, 2025 (the &ldquo;<B>Amendment Effective Date</B>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the
Parties entered into a Distribution and Services Agreement effective September 8, 2023 (the &ldquo;<B>Original Agreement</B>&rdquo;);
and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the
Parties agreed to amend the Original Agreement on March 1, 2024 (the &ldquo;<B>First Amendment</B>&rdquo;) to change certain provisions;
and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the
Parties agreed to amend the Original Agreement, as modified by the First Amendment, on October 8, 2024 (the &ldquo;Erroneous Second Amendment&rdquo;)
to change certain provisions;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the
Parties agreed to amend the Original Agreement, as modified by the First Amendment and Erroneous Second Amendment, on October 8, 2024
(the &ldquo;Amended and Restated <B>Second Amendment</B>&rdquo;) to change certain provisions (i.e., correct errors in Exhibit B);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the
Parties agreed to amend the Original Agreement, as modified by the Third Amendment, on June 1, 2025 (the &ldquo;<B>Third Amendment</B>&rdquo;)
to change certain provisions; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">WHEREAS, the
Parties desire to amend certain provisions of the Original Agreement, as modified by the First Amendment, Erroneous Second Amendment,
the Amended and Restated Second Amendment, and the Third Amendment as set forth in this Fourth Amendment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">NOW THEREFORE,
in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein and for other good and valuable consideration, the undersigned
hereby agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">1.&nbsp;<U>Recitals</U>;
<U>Definitions</U>. Each and all of the foregoing recitals are true and correct and are incorporated herein by reference. The Original
Agreement, as modified by the First Amendment, the Amended and Restated Second Amendment, and the Third Amendment is referred to herein
as the &ldquo;Current Agreement.&rdquo; All capitalized terms used but not defined in this Fourth Amendment shall have the meaning set
forth in the Current Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">2.&nbsp;<U>Amendment
of Exhibit B</U>. Exhibit B to the Current Agreement is hereby deleted and <U>Exhibit B</U> hereto is substituted therefor.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-indent: 0.5in">3.&nbsp;<U>Entire&nbsp;Agreement</U>.&nbsp;This
Fourth Amendment constitutes the entire understanding to date of the Parties hereto regarding the subject matter of this
Fourth Amendment and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous oral and written agreements of the Parties thereto with respect to the
subject matter of this Fourth Amendment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">4.&nbsp;<U>Counterparts</U>.
This Fourth Amendment may be executed in any number of counterparts with the same effect as if all of the Parties to this Fourth Amendment
had signed the same document. All counterparts shall be construed together and shall constitute one agreement. A signed copy of this Fourth
Amendment delivered by facsimile, email, or other means of electronic transmission (including pdf or any electronic signature complying
with the U.S. federal ESIGN Act of 2000, e.g., www.docusign.com) shall be deemed to have the same
legal effect as delivery of an original signed copy of this Fourth Amendment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">5.&nbsp;<U>Conflicting
Provisions</U>. This Fourth Amendment is intended to supplement the Current Agreement, and the provisions of this Fourth Amendment and
the Current Agreement shall be construed to the maximum extent possible in the manner necessary to avoid any conflict between their respective
terms and conditions. In the event of any irreconcilable conflict between the terms of this Fourth Amendment and the Current Agreement,
the terms of this Fourth Amendment shall govern and control.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0 0pt">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have caused this Fourth
Amendment to be executed as of the Effective Date by their respective duly authorized officers.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>
